From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-10 09:15 -0700
Subject: Redwood Trial: success metrics & timeline

Hi Priya — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and the proposed next steps so we have alignment before we send an updated SOW. TL;DR: baseline week, integrate two prioritized intents, run evals, handoff.

Agreed success criteria (as discussed):
- Intent classification: F1 >= 88% initially (open to rebaseline after adding new intents)
- Latency: p95 generation < 350ms for 512-token requests
- Throughput: sustained 100–120 req/min under expected traffic profile
- Error rate: <1% for inference errors / timeouts
- Data handling: logs retained 30 days, redaction applied to PII before storage

Proposed timeline (starting when we have signed SOW + data access):
- Week 0: kickoff + data ingest (sample exports, API keys)
- Week 1: integrate core intents (checkout, order-status) + baseline metrics
- Week 2: add search/FAQ routing + small-scale A/B evaluation
- Week 3: evaluate, produce success report and handoff to ops / CS

Attachments: trial-checklist.xlsx (initial success matrix & owners)

Open questions / asks for Cedar:
1) Can you confirm procurement contact & target signature date?
2) Are there any additional intents you want prioritized at kickoff? (we'll need examples)
3) Any strict SLA/retention requirements beyond what we discussed?

If this looks good I'll update the SOW to reflect the baseline criteria and timeline and share with your procurement. Proposed kickoff window: week of Aug 24.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Thanks Ben — very helpful recap. A few updates from our side after sharing with ops and product:

1) Add one more use case to the trial scope: "Returns processing / refund eligibility extraction" — this is a high ROI flow for Q4 and we want to validate the model on our parsed return notes.
2) Can we tighten the intent F1 target to 92%? If that's unrealistic initially, we can capture a rebaseline milestone at the mid-point of the trial (week 2).
3) Security: procurement wants a short list of SOC2 artifacts (audit report, scope) and our security team asked for data flow diagram — can you point us to the right evidence?

Procurement contact is procurement@cedarretail.com (cc'd). Target signature goal is Aug 20 if possible — happy to expedite on our end.

I'll wait for your updated SOW and checklist with the returns use case included.

Best,
